name: agentify
description: A committed-spec engineering lifecycle for Claude Code, and the plain-words reporting style that goes with it.

plugins.name: lifecycle
plugins.description: The full ticket-to-green-branch lifecycle as callable skills: frame, grill, spec, plan, plan-check, build, plus tdd, diagnose, resolve-conflicts and show, and the six sub-agents they dispatch. Type /advance and it runs whichever phase comes next. Reads how your repo works — gates, tracker, forge, naming, review lenses, loop caps and the per-call effort budget — from eight files under .agents/, written by /onboard.

plugins.name: plain-words
plugins.description: Report in Simplified Technical English: small words, one idea per sentence, what you did, whether it worked, what to do now. Two options and a recommendation when a decision is needed.
